T2.5.title: World maps
T2.5.summary: The game world unpacked into loadable maps (README.md): the overworld (regions 0-7 stitched, 2048x1024 tiles), 62 building interiors, 5 dungeons and the astral plane, each cut from the shared indoor sheet by walking from its doors (fmain.c:1919-1927, 1944-1950, 1784-1789; px_to_im/prox fsubs.asm:548-614, 1590-1611). Every map ships tiles.png (8-bit: original tile id in its tileset region) and master.png (16-bit: master atlas index, which also carries collision) plus a preview rendered from the real tiles with entry points ringed in magenta and openable doors (gates, secret doors, tunnels) outlined in cyan. Names are the review's (e.g. Marheim castle, Citadel of Doom, Forbidden Keep, Tambry/Marheim houses); each map.json keeps the doorlist comment as source_name and the game's own place names from narr.asm. Review by looking at the previews: each should be a complete, recognisable place with its entrance where you remember it; nothing from a neighbouring building should bleed in.

items.title: maps.json — 69 maps
items.look_for: One row per map: overworld, astral plane, 5 dungeons (dragon cave, witchwood cave, spider pit, tombs, troll cave; region 9), 62 interiors (region 8): marheim castle + marheim 10-19, tambry tavern + tambry 2-8, citadel of doom, forbidden keep, witch's castle, crystal palace, keeps, forts, inns, cabins, oases. The entries column names what leads in: desert fort has 4 (identical doorlist rows), crystal palace 2, citadel of doom lists its door and the portal back from the astral plane, spider pit the quicksand drop, every cabin its own yard gate and door. Each map directory holds tiles.png / master.png (8- and 16-bit index layers, data not pictures) and preview.png.

items.title: Overworld — 2048x1024 tiles, regions F1-F8 stitched
items.look_for: The whole continent at 1/4 scale (8192x8192): snowfield top-left, witch wood top-right, swamp and dark forest left of centre, Tambry's roads and the plains in the middle, the Burning Waste desert and the volcanic waste with lava bottom-left, Marheim's grey castle with the orange farm grid on the bay, the mountain ridges of the south-east. No seams or misaligned strips where the eight regions meet (rows 256/512/768, column 1024). Tiny magenta rings sit on every door (zoom in on Tambry or Marheim) and one on the quicksand cell north-east of Tambry.

items.title: Dungeons — tombs, dragon cave, witchwood cave, spider pit, troll cave (region 9 tileset)
items.look_for: Five separate cave systems in dark dungeon stone, each one connected piece with black outside. Every openable door tile is outlined in cyan with its open_list name: SECRET and TUNNEL are the hidden doors (drawn as plain wall), VGATE/HGATE the visible gates, GOLDEN/BLUE/CABINET the special ones. Tombs (of Hemsath): the long left corridor linking the winding passages, the square grid maze and the lower-left block complex (dense with SECRET/VGATE); one ring at the stair entrance. Dragon cave: the big system with its wide room complex on the right — the stray wall stub that used to float right of centre is gone. Witchwood cave: the two maze-cave entrances ring the same system. Spider pit: two rings — the cave-mouth exit and the quicksand drop point. Troll cave: a small cave.

items.title: Astral plane — 212x68, via the portal in the Citadel of Doom
items.look_for: A large blue starfield rectangle (the Spirit Plane extent 0x2400-0x3100 x 0x8200-0x8a00) with the arrival point ringed ('portal from citadel of doom'). The Citadel of Doom preview shows its door and the 'portal to astral plane' ring in the main hall; the portal is inside the citadel, not in any cave.

items.title: Castles and palaces — Marheim castle, witch's castle, crystal palace, mammoth manor, elf glade, forbidden keep
items.look_for: Marheim castle (castle of King Mar): grey walls around green courtyards and two red-carpet throne rooms, door ringed on the right. Witch's castle: dark stone keep. Crystal palace: blue crystal halls, two rings at its double door. Mammoth manor (Vermillion Manor): a long low hall. Elf glade: a walled sanctuary. Forbidden keep (the doorlist's 'unreachable castle', reached by swan to rescue the princess): a small stone hall. Each is one building with black around it; cyan outlines mark openable doors.

items.title: Keeps — 7 stone keeps (17x10) and 5 marble keeps (14x8)
items.look_for: Two families of near-identical floor plans (the keeps share sector layouts): seven HSTONE keeps and five MARBLE keeps, each a single walled hall with its door ringed at the bottom. Furnishing differs slightly between them.

items.title: Forts and inns — plain/gate/pass fort, desert fort, forest/road's end/friendly inn
items.look_for: Three small black-stone forts (10x7) with one ring each; the desert fort with its four coincident rings (one per doorlist row); three identical inn floor plans (17x11) with beds and tables, door ringed at the bottom.

items.title: Cabins #1-#10 (12x9 each)
items.look_for: Ten log cabins: an orange-floored one-room cabin with a bed, each with a fenced yard. Cabin and yard are one map, two rings each: the yard gate and the cabin door. Cabins 4, 5 and 9 get their gates by correction — the source table sends those gates into cabins 7, 8 and 6 (source bug, PROBLEMS.md P27; the original values are kept in map.json entries[].fix).

items.title: Oases #1-#5, swamp shack, light house, crypt
items.look_for: Five desert oasis interiors (small walled courtyards, DESERT doors), the swamp shack, the light house (a tiny 8x8 room) and the crypt (8x6). One ring each.

items.title: Tambry — tavern and houses 2-8
items.look_for: The Tambry tavern (two rings: doors 1.a and 1.b open into the same house) and seven small wooden village houses (orange floors, beds, tables). Adjacent houses on the indoor sheet are cut apart: no second house inside a box.

items.title: Marheim — houses 10-19
items.look_for: Ten stone city houses, several only 3x2 tiles of floor. Marheim 15 has two rings (doors 15.a and 15.b). The houses sit wall-to-wall on the indoor sheet; each map holds exactly one house with shared walls kept and the neighbour's floor blanked.
